items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: And Freddie Greene had lost his out in California when we were making a movie.

ctx.x: Well now, you're with Basie right up until the time you go in the Army?

Yes. Until 1943. We had made a picture in California and I had lost my, my card. I don't know what, you know, your rating card, whatever your number is. And Freddie Greene had lost his out in California when we were making a movie. And he was walking down Hollywood Boulevard looking at some men's clothes and we were making a picture at Columbia studio. And for some reason the cop walked up to Freddie and says, where's your card? him Freddie didn't have a card. So they put/in jail because he didn't have, he had…

We went back to the studio and everybody was waiting for Freddie, no Freddie. We waited and waited. Finally we had to go ahead and make the picture without Freddie because he stayed in jail overnight.
